top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete and mature chain of discovery: GLP-1 physiology and secretion in humans (Holst), identification of the bioactive truncated peptide (Mojsov), and the incretin and GLP-1 receptor biology that established the therapeutic rationale (Drucker), confirmed by large randomized outcome trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The three-laureate allocation fits the foundational contributions and the citation is scoped to physiology and bioactive form, not to individual drug products. No award would leave unrecognised work of clear benefit to humankind.
